title: Apply Pneumatic LOTO at an Operator Station Shut-off Valve
summary: Safely isolate the pneumatic supply for a specific OptiSweep operator station by turning that station’s pneumatic shut-off valve to OFF and applying LOTO to secure the OFF position.
when_to_use: Use when you need to isolate pneumatic power for a specific operator station by securing its pneumatic shut-off valve in the OFF position with LOTO.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical valve OFF action and apply LOTO to secure the OFF position for the targeted operator station.
safety_notes: Each operator station has its own pneumatic shut-off valve; ensure you isolate the correct station before applying LOTO.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the operator station pneumatic shut-off valve
LOTO hardware (lock and tag) appropriate for the site procedure

steps.title: Identify the operator station’s pneumatic shut-off valve
steps.purpose: Ensure the correct operator station pneumatic supply is isolated before turning the valve OFF and applying LOTO.
steps.instruction: Locate the pneumatic shut-off valve for the specific operator station you need to isolate (each operator station has its own shut-off valve).
steps.expected_result: You have positively identified the pneumatic shut-off valve that corresponds to the targeted operator station.
steps.healthy_condition: The valve you selected is clearly associated with the targeted operator station (not another station).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot positively identify the correct operator station’s pneumatic shut-off valve.

actions.label: Identify correct station valve
actions.exact_action: Each operator station has its own shut-off valve.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot positively identify the correct operator station’s shut-off valve.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Each operator station has its own shut-off valve.”

steps.title: Turn the shut-off valve to OFF
steps.purpose: Place the targeted operator station pneumatic supply into the OFF state prior to lockout/tagout.
steps.instruction: Turn the identified shut-off valve to “OFF.”
steps.expected_result: The targeted operator station pneumatic shut-off valve is in the OFF position.
steps.healthy_condition: The valve handle/indicator shows OFF for the targeted station.
steps.failure_condition: The valve does not remain in the OFF position after turning it to OFF (unexpected movement/behavior).
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the valve does not remain in the OFF position after turning it to OFF (unexpected movement/behavior).

steps.title: Apply LOTO to the valve
steps.purpose: Secure the OFF position so pneumatic power remains isolated during the work.
steps.instruction: Apply LOTO to the valve to lockout/tagout the OFF position.
steps.expected_result: The targeted operator station pneumatic shut-off valve is secured with LOTO in the OFF position.
steps.healthy_condition: A lock and tag are applied such that the valve remains secured in OFF.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO is not applied to secure the OFF position (valve not secured/lockout not present).

success_criteria: The targeted operator station pneumatic shut-off valve is in the OFF position.
The OFF position is secured with LOTO.
healthy_conditions: Correct station valve identified (each operator station has its own shut-off valve).
Valve remains in OFF position after turning it to OFF.
failure_conditions: Cannot positively identify the correct operator station’s shut-off valve.
Valve does not remain in the OFF position after turning it to OFF (unexpected movement/behavior).
Valve OFF position is not secured with LOTO.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot positively identify the correct operator station’s shut-off valve.
Stop and escalate if the valve does not remain in the OFF position after turning it to OFF (unexpected movement/behavior).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: “Each operator station has its own shut-off valve. 1. Turn the shut-off valve to ‘OFF.’ 2. LOTO the valve.”

missing_details: No additional live observable checks (e.g., pneumatic pressure indicators) are provided in the supplied section excerpt beyond valve OFF position and LOTO application.
